sampleRows.release_title: Initiative properties Centrally manage access to Linear’s MCP server in Claude ⁠ Share filtered views ⁠
sampleRows.summary: Initiatives define your company’s high-level goals and organize the projects that contribute to them. To help you manage initiatives as your roadmap grows, we’ve added a new set of focused initiative properties:

sampleRows.release_title: Agent assisted project updates Desktop navigation history and pinned tabs ⁠ Private sub-teams ⁠ Build agents with Vercel Eve ⁠ Release pipeline changelogs ⁠ OAuth application manifests ⁠
sampleRows.summary: Project and initiative updates keep teams aligned, but writing them means pulling out recent changes from issues, documents, and discussions.

sampleRows.release_title: Text attribution and agent-assisted editing Refreshed issue sidebar ⁠
sampleRows.summary: Documents and project descriptions are critical context for your teams and agents.
Loops are a new way for Linear Agent to take on recurring work for your team.

Agents generate large volumes of code, but individuals are still accountable for the changes that merge. This leads to a lot of review work, and the capability and performance of traditional review tools hasn’t kept up.

sampleRows.release_title: Coding sessions: environments, browser use, and updated pricing Configurable environments ⁠ Browser testing ⁠ Transparent pricing ⁠
sampleRows.summary: Linear Agent can now set up, run, and test your code before returning its work. That means fewer handoffs and changes that are further along when they come back to you.

sampleRows.release_title: Team documents Shared skills for Linear Agent ⁠ Issue description comments ⁠
sampleRows.summary: Important team context doesn’t always belong in a specific issue, project, or initiative. Teams also need a dedicated place for the notes, docs, and shared references that support their work over time. Now, every team has a page to keep its context organized and easy to access.

sampleRows.release_title: Coding sessions on mobile Guided Reviews are now generally available ⁠ Support for GitHub teams in reviews ⁠ Signed commits for coding sessions ⁠ GitHub Copilot for Linear ⁠
sampleRows.summary: Your coding session doesn’t have to stop when you leave your desk. Use the Linear mobile app to review code changes, comment on specific lines, and iterate with Linear Agent.

sampleRows.release_title: Team initiatives Enterprise-managed authorization for MCP ⁠
sampleRows.summary: Initiatives are Linear’s way to manage product strategy and high-level planning across projects. Strategy may start at the company level, but teams carry it forward. You can now assign a team to lead an initiative, making it clear who is responsible for driving the work and how it contributes to the broader direction.

sampleRows.release_title: Coding sessions in Linear A coding agent your team will love ⁠ Automate the first pass ⁠ Availability and pricing ⁠
sampleRows.summary: Earlier this year, we launched Linear Agent , giving teams a new way to plan and coordinate their issues and projects. Since then, we’ve added Code Intelligence to extend that understanding to the codebase, and MCP support to bring all of your context together.
